The '''monmon seed''' was a special seed from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. When properly collected and polished, they made for a lucrative trade item.

[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] prepared such a supply for the annual village expedition to [[Mooth]]'s [[Mooth's trading post|trading post]]. Mooth was interested enough to offer the young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] a "lucky" stone, which he gave to his loved sweetheart, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]].
